summary: The migration uses a staged rollout with a state-only deploy_new: first a SQL expand stage sanitizes referrer_id data, then the new version is deployed without schema changes, the old version retires, and finally a SQL contract stage adds the ForeignKey constraint.
write_consistency: During the overlap, referrer_id stays as a NULLable integer column; both old and new apps write integer values compatibly. The FK constraint is postponed until after retire_old to avoid constraint violations during concurrent traffic.

stages.description: Set referrer_id to NULL for values not present in the account_user primary key table to ensure referential integrity.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET referrer_id = NULL WHERE referrer_id IS NOT NULL AND referrer_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM account_user);

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version so that only the new version operates on the database.
Add ForeignKey constraint on referrer_id referencing account_user.id, finalizing the schema change.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT fk_account_user_referrer FOREIGN KEY (referrer_id) REFERENCES account_user (id);
